en.headline: Yiu Hing-leung appointed first CEO of Hung Shui Kiu Industry Park Company
en.dek: The company said Yiu, a former Hong Kong Science and Technology Parks executive, will take up the three-year post on 1 December after open recruitment and Chief Executive approval.
body: The Hung Shui Kiu Industry Park Company announced on Friday the appointment of Yiu Hing-leung as its first chief executive officer. He will assume duty on 1 December for a three-year term following an open recruitment exercise and approval by the Chief Executive.

Yiu has more than 30 years of experience in the technology and industrial sectors. He previously held senior roles at the Hong Kong Science and Technology Parks Corporation, including chief corporate development officer and head of innofacturing, where he led the transformation of industrial estates into InnoParks and oversaw technology clusters and incubation programmes.

The wholly government-owned company is responsible for developing and operating the approximately 27.5-hectare industry park in Hung Shui Kiu. It aims to attract high-value-added manufacturing such as pharmaceuticals and food processing, capitalising on the site’s proximity to Qianhai in Shenzhen. The board of directors was appointed earlier this year.

zh.headline: 姚慶良獲聘洪水橋產業園公司首任行政總裁
zh.dek: 洪水橋產業園公司宣布，姚慶良將於12月1日起出任首任行政總裁，任期三年，經公開招聘及行政長官批准。
body: 洪水橋產業園有限公司周五宣布，經公開招聘及行政長官批准後，聘任姚慶良為首任行政總裁。他將於12月1日履新，任期三年。
姚慶良在科技及工業界擁有逾30年經驗。他曾於香港科技園公司擔任多個高層職位，包括企業發展總監及創新製造總監，主導將工業邨轉型為「創新園」，並推動科技產業集群及培育計劃。
該公司由財政司司長法團全資擁有，負責發展及營運約27.5公頃的洪水橋產業園，目標吸引高增值製造業如藥品製造及食品加工，善用鄰近深圳前海的地理位置優勢。公司董事局已於今年較早時獲委任。
